headline: France and Senegal clash in World Cup opener
summary: Kylian Mbappe leads Les Bleus as they face Senegal in a Group I match, with William Saliba starting despite back pain.
details: France and Senegal face off in a high-stakes Group I clash to kick off France's World Cup campaign on Tuesday.
France coach Didier Deschamps has named William Saliba to start in central defence, despite the player struggling with back pain.
In attack, Deschamps has opted for Desire Doue, while Rayan Cherki and Bradley Barcola remain on the bench.
Senegal's lineup features Lamine Camara in midfield, with Habib Diarra left as a substitute.

The French starting XI includes Mike Maignan, Jules Kounde, Dayot Upamecano, William Saliba, Theo Hernandez, Aurelien Tchouameni, Adrien Rabiot, Michael Olise, Kylian Mbappe, Desire Doue, and Ousmane Dembele.

Senegal's starting XI consists of Edouard Mendy, Krepin Diatta, Kalidou Koulibaly, Moussa Niakhate, El Hadji Malick Diouf, Idrissa Gana Gueye, Lamine Camara, Pape Gueye, Ismaila Sarr, Sadio Mane, and Nicolas Jackson.
caption:
Mbappe vs Mane: A World Cup showdown begins!

France and Senegal face off in a high-stakes Group I clash to kick off France's World Cup campaign on Tuesday.

France coach Didier Deschamps has named William Saliba to start in central defence, despite the player struggling with back pain.

In attack, Deschamps has opted for Desire Doue, while Rayan Cherki and Bradley Barcola remain on the bench.

Senegal's lineup features Lamine Camara in midfield, with Habib Diarra left as a substitute.

The French starting XI includes Mike Maignan, Jules Kounde, Dayot Upamecano, William Saliba, Theo Hernandez, Aurelien Tchouameni, Adrien Rabiot, Michael Olise, Kylian Mbappe, Desire Doue, and Ousmane Dembele.

Senegal's starting XI consists of Edouard Mendy, Krepin Diatta, Kalidou Koulibaly, Moussa Niakhate, El Hadji Malick Diouf, Idrissa Gana Gueye, Lamine Camara, Pape Gueye, Ismaila Sarr, Sadio Mane, and Nicolas Jackson.

headline: Economic update: Bangladesh's foreign reserves increase
summary: The country's foreign currency reserves have seen an upward trend, providing a boost to economic stability.
details: Bangladesh's foreign currency reserves have increased, according to recent reports. This growth is seen as a positive sign for the country's economic stability.
The increase in reserves is crucial for managing imports and ensuring the stability of the the national currency.
The development comes amid ongoing efforts to stabilize the economy and manage foreign exchange liquidity.
Additionally, reports indicate positive news for depositors of Islami Bank who were previously concerned about their funds.
caption:
Bangladesh's foreign reserves are on the rise, signaling a boost for the economic outlook.

Bangladesh's foreign currency reserves have increased, according to recent reports. This growth is seen as a positive sign for the country's economic stability.

The increase in reserves is crucial for managing imports and ensuring the stability of the the national currency.

The development comes amid ongoing efforts to stabilize the economy and manage foreign exchange liquidity.

Additionally, reports indicate positive news for depositors of Islami Bank who were previously concerned about their funds.
